limitations_and_boundaries: scGen has been trained on relatively small data sets that only reflect subsets of biological and transcriptional variability.
A trained model cannot be expected to be predictive beyond the domain of the training data.
To gain confidence in predictions, one needs realistic error estimates by holding out parts of the data with known ground truth.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

methods.protocol_description: Two latent difference vectors are computed: δ_LPS (LPS vs. control) and δ_species (species differences). For predicting rat LPS cells: z_rat_LPS = 0.5 * (z_mouse_LPS + δ_species + z_rat_control + δ_LPS). Orthologs are used.

methods.name: scGen prediction of held-out cell types
methods.protocol_description: For each held-out cell type (e.g., CD4-T cells), the perturbation vector δ is estimated from the latent representations of perturbed vs. control cells of other cell types. Then the latent representation of control cells of the held-out type is shifted by δ, and the decoder generates the predicted perturbed expression.

experiments_or_tasks: Developed scGen, a VAE combined with vector arithmetics in latent space to predict perturbation response.

methods.name: scGen (VAE + latent vector arithmetics)
methods.protocol_description: scGen uses a variational autoencoder (VAE) to model the conditional distribution P(x_i|z_i, p_i), where x_i is expression profile, z_i is low-dimensional latent representation, and p_i is the condition (unperturbed/perturbed). Latent space vector arithmetics is used to extrapolate to unseen conditions: δ = avg(z_condition=1) - avg(z_condition=0). For out-of-sample predictions, the perturbation vector is computed from training cell types and applied to held-out cell types. Architecture adapted for scRNA-seq data. Implemented in TensorFlow and Scanpy.

study_units.name: Main prediction framework and architecture
